tools.description: List or acknowledge daemon alerts.
tools.name: alerts

tools.description: Local blob cache: stats or clear. Ask: "How big is the cache?"

kind.description: Cache kind to clear; empty clears all.

tools.name: cache

tools.description: Inspect a crashed-process core file and suggest offline analyzers. Ask: "What crashed in this core dump?"

executable.description: Optional path to the crashed executable.

tools.name: core

tools.description: Read-only database inspection (postgres, mysql, sqlite, mongodb, redis). Ask: "What database does this app use?" "Show its schema."
tools.name: db

tools.description: Mobile devices in use: Android devices and emulators adb reaches (USB, emulator, adb connect) with each emulator's avd, booted iOS simulators (macOS), and emulator/simulator processes attributed to roots. Same JSON as `spectra devices --json`. Ask: "Which emulators are booted, and which worktree started them?"

all_simulators.description: Also list simulators that are not booted (ios_simulators.all). macOS only.

roots.description: Absolute worktree roots to attribute emulator and simulator processes to.

start_adb.description: Ask adb even if no adb server runs (default: only if one does). Starts a server that keeps running.

tools.name: devices

tools.description: Run rules. Finds risky app, JVM, network, storage, and toolchain state. Ask: "What needs attention?"

thread_dump_pids.description: JVM PIDs to thread-dump for jvm-deadlock (live only).

tools.name: diagnose

tools.description: Current daemon host health and optional recent samples.
tools.name: host_health

tools.description: Long-idle holders: processes under roots or in pids, older than min_age, whose tree stayed under max_cpu over the window. Evidence only, never signals. Same JSON as `spectra idle --json`. Ask: "Which lane processes are stuck doing nothing?"

max_cpu.description: Idle threshold: tree CPU under this percent of one CPU (default 1).

min_age.description: Only processes alive at least this Go duration (default "10m").

pids.description: PIDs to check (with or instead of roots; one of them is required).

roots.description: Absolute directories whose processes are checked.

window.description: CPU sample Go duration (100ms..30s, default "5s"); the call blocks this long.

tools.name: idle

tools.description: macOS only. Inspect .app bundles: runtime, security, helpers, deps, storage, processes. Ask: "What is this app built with?"

assess_gatekeeper.description: Run spctl's Gatekeeper assessment (slow, 15s cap per app) instead of inferring it from the signature.

deep.description: Join live process, open-FD/listening-port, and connection state for each app.

scan_all.description: Inspect every .app under /Applications instead of listing paths.

tools.name: inspect_app

tools.description: Persisted findings and fix history. Ask: "What issues are open?"
tools.name: issues

tools.description: Cancel a working job: it becomes cancelled at once, its tool is stopped, and its record is returned.

job_id.description: Job ID from job_start or job_list.

tools.name: job_cancel

tools.description: This session's jobs, oldest first, including finished ones until they expire.
tools.name: job_list

tools.description: The wrapped tool's result, exactly as a direct call returns it, once the job is completed or failed. Errors while working.

job_id.description: Job ID from job_start or job_list.

tools.name: job_result

tools.description: Run a slow tool in the background and return its job record (as job_status) at once. process only for operation=sample, jvm only for flamegraph, snapshot only for create or baseline; arguments are checked now. Poll job_status until completed, failed or cancelled, then fetch the result with job_result. Ask: "Trace spawns for 30s without blocking."

arguments.description: The wrapped tool's arguments, as for a direct call.

tools.name: job_start

tools.description: A job's record, with the latest progress its tool reported; ttl and pollInterval are in ms.

job_id.description: Job ID from job_start or job_list.

tools.name: job_status

tools.description: JVM debug. heap_leak_suspects analyzes the .hprof at dest (leak suspects by retained size, accumulation points, GC-root paths; needs confirm_sensitive). mbeans, mbean_read, mbean_invoke and probe need the spectra agent, auto-attached unless auto_attach=false. Ask: "Why is PID 123 using heap?"

attribute.description: MBean attribute name (e.g. HeapMemoryUsage). Required for mbean_read.

auto_attach.description: Auto-attach the spectra agent for agent-only ops (default true).

event.description: Profiler event (jvm flamegraph): cpu, wall, alloc, lock, itimer or ctimer.

mbean_name.description: MBean ObjectName (e.g. java.lang:type=Memory). Required for mbean_read and mbean_invoke.

mbean_operation.description: MBean operation name. Required for mbean_invoke.

tools.name: jvm

tools.description: Ancestors and descendant tree of one pid, with subtree RSS and CPU. Same JSON as `spectra lineage --json`. Ask: "What started PID 123 and what is under it?"
tools.name: lineage

tools.description: Can this machine take another job, and if not, who is using it? Same JSON as `spectra load --json`; verdict is admit, hold or backoff. On Linux under a cgroup limit it adds cgroup and effective_cpus / effective_available_bytes. Ask: "Should I start another lane?"

backoff_free_gb.description: Back off when available memory is below this many GiB (default 4).

max_load_per_cpu.description: Hold when 1-minute load is at or above this times the CPU count (default 1.5).

min_free_gb.description: Hold when available memory is below this many GiB (default 8).

roots.description: Absolute directories holding worktrees; cause is "roots" when load leads there.

tools.name: load

tools.description: macOS only. Bounded unified-log queries. Ask: "Show recent errors from backupd."
tools.name: logs

tools.description: Memory pressure and swap: VM compressor on macOS; MemAvailable, PSI stalls and zswap on Linux. Ask: "Is the system under memory pressure?"
tools.name: memory

tools.description: Locally stored process metrics and app churn. Ask: "How has PID 123's memory trended?"
tools.name: metrics

tools.description: Network state and sockets. Ask: "What is this app connected to?"
tools.name: network

tools.description: Leftover processes from worktrees and finished jobs: parent is pid 1 and cwd is under a root. Evidence only, never kills. Same JSON as `spectra orphans --json`; groups also hold daemon_by_design processes. Ask: "What did finished lanes leave running?"

min_age.description: Ignore processes younger than this Go duration (default "1m").

no_daemon.description: Do not ask the running daemon for recorded spawn origins.

tools.name: orphans

tools.description: Who has this port, path or pid (target), or what runs under these directories (under)? Same JSON as `spectra owner [--under] --json`. Ask: "Who is listening on 8080?" "Is anything still running in this worktree?"

target.description: :PORT, tcp:PORT, udp:PORT, an absolute path, or a pid. Exactly one of target or under.

under.description: Absolute directories: list processes whose cwd is inside.

tools.name: owner

tools.description: Built-in diagnostic playbooks and command plans. Ask: "How do I triage an fseventsd leak?"
tools.name: playbook

tools.description: Battery, thermal, and energy impact. Ask: "Is the machine throttling?" "What is draining the battery?"

pids.description: PIDs to score (impact). Defaults to all processes.

tools.name: power

tools.description: Live processes; by_app and sample are macOS only. Ask: "What is using memory?" "Sample PID 123."
tools.name: process

tools.description: macOS only. launchd jobs and plist schedules. Ask: "What launch agents are installed?"
tools.name: services

tools.description: Capture, list or diff host state snapshots and baselines. Ask: "What changed since baseline?"
tools.name: snapshot

tools.description: Bounded live trace of process starts and exits by polling; blocks for the duration (at most 30s). events are the lines `spectra spawns --json` streams, summary its final line. Ask: "What keeps spawning under PID 123?"

pid.description: Only trace this process and its descendants (0 or omitted: all).

tools.name: spawns

tools.description: Disk volumes and ~/Library storage footprint. Ask: "What is using all my disk?"

limit.description: How many top apps to report (default 10).

paths.description: .app paths to size for the largest-apps list.

tools.name: storage

tools.description: Kernel resource limits and saturation; top lists the holders. Ask: "Are we running out of file descriptors or PTYs?"
tools.name: system

tools.description: macOS only. Time Machine status, destinations, and local snapshots. Ask: "When did Time Machine last back up?"
tools.name: timemachine

tools.description: Dev tools (JDKs, runtimes, build tools, brew) and drift. Ask: "Which JDKs are installed?"
tools.name: toolchain

tools.description: Best first tool. Give app_path, pid, bundle_id, or symptom. Returns summary, evidence, next steps. Ask: "What looks wrong with Slack?"
tools.name: triage

tools.description: macOS only. Install/update history and install.log. Ask: "When was the last OS update?"
tools.name: updates

resources.name: Debug Workflows
